Each February, the search begins: something red, something pink, something that says the night was planned. This Valentine's lingerie edit answers with twelve pieces in the colors of the season — deep lace in true red, a pink sling nightdress that flirts with sweet, wine-red slits, mesh suspender slips in passionate pink. From a full Valentine's lingerie set in lace to a daring jumpsuit with cut-outs, every piece is chosen for the one night a year when lingerie is the gift and the greeting card both. Pick your shade, pick your cut, and let the evening handle itself.

How to Shop for Valentine's Lingerie

Anchor the look in color: true red reads bold and classic, pink stays playful and sweet, and wine tones split the difference. Then match the cut to the evening — a lace set for gift-box drama, a slit nightdress when the night is long, a jumpsuit when you want the whole statement in one piece. Sizing runs standard, so trust your usual letter and the chart for anything strapless. And since February photographs everything, choose lace and mesh that flatter in low light; the right shade does half the work before you even slip it on.

Browse the Valentine's edit below — twelve reds and pinks for February.
